text:
Tara (product): Thinking about an 'Invocation Sparkline' row in Cost Dashboard: tiny visual + per-invocation amortized cache credit and a 'what-if no-cache' delta. Need agreement on telemetry & API shape so design can mock.
Diego (eng): +1. Backend constraints: we can't pull full traces for every row. Need a pre-agg summary for the tile and sampled full traces for popover.
Sam P (platform): Telemetry gaps: no slab_id today and model_variant sometimes defaulted away in fallbacks. We'll need to attach slab_id and variant_id in router events.
Rin (design): UI: show sparkline for cost over time, small stacked micro-bar for prompt/completion/cached, and a badge with "amortized credit". Popover lazy-loads detailed JSON. Show "confidence" when sampled.
econ-bot: Note: current full-trace sampling = 0.5%. Increasing to 1% ~x3 storage for traces and impacts query p95.
Tara (product): Proposed API: GET /v1/costs/invocations?summarize=true&start=...&end=...&expand=trace,slab&sample_pct=0.5
Tara (product): example minimal response (summary rows only): [ { "invocation_id":"inv_abc123", "ts":"2026-03-15T12:05:00Z", "top_model":"r-v2-3B", "tokens_prompt":"20", "tokens_completion":"80", "tokens_cached":"14", "amortized_cache_credit_usd":"0.0013", "cost_usd":"0.0042", "simulate_no_cache_usd":"0.0055", "slab_id":"slab_20260315_x" } ]
Diego (eng): Implementation plan: hourly pre-agg table keyed by slab_id with avoided_tokens and cost_rate. Summary endpoint joins to hourly pre-agg and amortizes credit based on slab_scope. We avoid touching raw traces except on expand.
Sam P (platform): We'll add slab_id (optional) and chosen_variant to telemetry proto; roll out behind flag. For shared slabs we prorate credit by active usage in the billing window.
Rin (design): Add a toggle for amortization mode (tenant / global / raw) and a tooltip that explains the formula. Also show a small "sampled" tag if expand=trace returned sampled data.
econ-bot: Warning: adding slab_id everywhere increases metric cardinality. Consider emitting slab_id only when a prefetch/prefill hit occurs.
Tara (product): Action items: Sam -> RFC for proto change and rollout plan (ETA 48h). Diego -> prototype hourly pre-agg and example SQL (ETA 1w). Rin -> mock + copy including confidence indicator (ETA 3d). Tara -> endpoint spec + rate-limit proposal for expand=trace (ETA 3d).
Diego (eng): Also recommend rate-limiting expand=trace and charging more points for expand queries; default page-size 200 and cursor pagination.
Sam P (platform): Agreed. I'll add quota rules and a soft limit that returns a small summary if exceeded.
Tara (product): Cool. Aim for alpha with 0.5% sampled traces + pre-agg tile next sprint. We'll iterate if costs are high.
Rin (design): I'll post Figma link in this thread when ready.
Tara (product): Thanks all. I'll follow up with the spec and link RFCs once Sam posts them. :rocket:
